split-cps-2k.name: 2K Split CPS
split-cps-2k.description: CPS threshold to split into 2 lanes

split-cps-3k.name: 3K Split CPS
split-cps-3k.description: CPS threshold to split into 3 lanes

split-cps-4k.name: 4K Split CPS
split-cps-4k.description: CPS threshold to split into 4 lanes

fully-random-mode.name: Fully Random Mode
fully-random-mode.description: Randomize lanes even at low CPS. If disabled, defaults to 1 key at low CPS.

comfort-mode.name: Comfort Mode
comfort-mode.description: If enabled, pressing one key prevents other keys from coming out (no multi-jacks).

skin-folder.name: Skin Folder
skin-folder.description: Name of the folder inside skins/ to use for note sprites (e.g., default)

lane-x-offset.name: Lane X Offset
lane-x-offset.description: Horizontal distance from the right edge of the screen

lane-y-offset.name: Lane Y Offset
lane-y-offset.description: Vertical distance from the bottom edge of the screen

lane-height.name: Lane Height
lane-height.description: The visual height of the lane box

hit-bar-y-offset.name: Accuracy Bar Offset
hit-bar-y-offset.description: Vertical offset for the Hit Error Bar

error-ms-y-offset.name: Error MS Y Offset
error-ms-y-offset.description: Vertical offset for the Error MS text label

hit-window-fps.name: Hit Window FPS
hit-window-fps.description: Base FPS for hit window. If 240: Gold <= 1/240s, White <= 2/240s, Green <= 4/240s, Blue <= 8/240s, Purple <= 12/240s

release-miss-threshold.name: Release Miss Threshold (ms)
release-miss-threshold.description: Notes shorter than this won't trigger a MISS on release. Set to -1 to disable release MISS judgment entirely.

hit-sound-volume.name: Hit Sound Volume
hit-sound-volume.description: Volume for hit.wav in your skin folder (0 to 100)

lane-opacity.name: Lane Press Opacity
lane-opacity.description: Opacity of the lane when pressed (0.0 to 1.0)
